📍 Diversion Points: Wazirabad–Signature Bridge, Chandgi Ram Akhada (towards IP College Red Light), Monastery Market U-turn (Closed)
📍 Roads Closed: Old Wazirabad Bridge, Loop from Chandgi Ram Akhada towards Yudhistir Setu, Loop from Yudhistir Setu towards Nigam Bodh Ghat
📍 Avoid the affected stretch, do not park roadside & plan travel in advance
📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels
